summary: A paraglider reported overdue north of Deep Lake on July 15, 2016 was located injured the following afternoon and flown to hospital. Garfield County Search and Rescue crews and a helicopter took part in the search.
notes: Reviewed October 11, 2026. Recovered the stable KMTS article, published Monday July 18, 2016, through the station’s own search. It reports the missing-person call late Friday (July 15), ground search beginning Saturday at 6 a.m., helicopter location around 1 p.m., and evacuation to Valley View Hospital. Calendar dates are derived from those weekday references. Replaces the unstable /page/284 archive citation.
